mapper.select: SELECT br.*, b.id as "book.id", b.title as "book.title", b.author as "book.author", b.publisher as "book.publisher", b.cover_url as "book.coverUrl", b.category as "book.category" FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.status = 2 ORDER BY br.return_time DESC

SELECT br.*, b.id as "book.id", b.title as "book.title", b.author as "book.author", b.publisher as "book.publisher", b.cover_url as "book.coverUrl", b.category as "book.category" FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.status = 1 ORDER BY br.due_time ASC
SELECT * FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
